what: Pattern organs #5: propose patterns from a domain's cases, keep only those that predict HELD-OUT cases graded by a rule (the forge), then BREED survivors into compound patterns that generalise better (the improve-itself half). A pattern survives only if it generalises.

claims.text: The real signal pattern generalises — it scores perfectly on held-out data
A non-generalising pattern is REJECTED on the held-out split
Overfit is caught — on a domain with no real pattern, NOTHING clears the bar
The signal is the only high-confidence survivor (held-out BA > 0.9)
Breeding IMPROVES on held-out beyond the best single feature (selection on train, judged on held-out)
The bred champion is the true 2-term conjunction and it generalises (held-out 1.0)
